item.title: Mostly dry week ahead
item.description: It's still looking dry for the majority of the post-Christmas weekend.The European model develops a line of showers & some T-storms during the day Sunday. The American model thinks they will just be scattered showers. Neither one looks impactful for us. Saturday night / Sunday morning, a few showers may drift through South & South east Missouri.-Greg@660weather

item.title: Vernon county disaster loan application deadline extended
item.description: The SBA approved a 60-day deadline extension for Physical Damage Loan applications, giving eligible homeowners, renters, businesses, and nonprofits a bit more time. The new deadline is February 20, 2026. Courtesy Nevada Police Department

item.title: Letters to the News-Review: Flock Cameras in Adrian, Concerns About AI Mass Surveillance
item.description: In the age of Big Tech and artificial intelligence (AI), concerns about privacy and personal data are often front page news. Fear of mass data gathering and spying by government agencies and corporations have left many wary of new AI technologies. All of this has come to a head in Adrian MO, where citizens are deeply disturbed by the presence of Flock mass AI surveillance cameras.
